analysis.overall: You had a strong day with 86% time in range and smooth overnight stability. The main challenges were a late-dinner spike yesterday evening and a mid-morning low today following early corrections.

events.title: Midday correction success
events.description: Starting yesterday above 200 mg/dL, small correction doses successfully guided your glucose down to around 100 mg/dL by 2:00 PM.

events.title: Dinner climbing peak
events.description: Multiple carb entries over the evening combined to push glucose up to a high of 219 mg/dL around 8:18 PM before insulin brought it down.

events.title: Late evening plateau
events.description: Glucose hovered around 180 mg/dL before bedtime, requiring repeated corrections that safely settled you into a smooth overnight range.

events.title: Morning low dip
events.description: Correction micro-doses given between 7:30 AM and 8:00 AM stacked up and drifted your glucose down to a low of 61 mg/dL.

events.title: Post-low rebound & breakfast
events.description: Treating the low combined with breakfast carbs briefly sent glucose up to 191 mg/dL before meal insulin quickly brought you back down.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Watch out for stacking small corrections in the early morning when glucose is near 80 mg/dL, as it led to an extended low today.
